prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TravelHub destination artwork, landscape card
Primary request: Create a finished pastel travel illustration of Milano, Italy, with the Duomo di Milano as the unmistakable main landmark.
Scene/backdrop: Piazza del Duomo at warm sunset; the cathedral's pale marble façade, dense Gothic spires, pinnacles and central doorway are architecturally recognizable. A restrained glimpse of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II arcade appears only at one edge as secondary context.
Subject: The Duomo fills roughly 55–65% of the composition and is the brightest, sharpest focal point. It must remain immediately recognizable at small card size.
Style/medium: Cohesive with an elegant vintage travel-poster collection; soft pastel gouache, delicate paper grain, simplified painterly planes with accurate landmark silhouette.
Composition/framing: Wide 2.1:1 landscape, full bleed, low eye-level view across the piazza, cathedral centered or slightly off-center, a few tiny pedestrians for scale.
Lighting/mood: Gentle golden-hour light, refined and nostalgic.
Color palette: Dusty blush and apricot sky, warm ivory and pale rose marble, muted slate blue and sage accents.
Constraints: original composition; no text, logos, branding, watermark or border.
Avoid: generic Italian streets, oversized people, modern skyscrapers, fantasy architecture, making the Galleria more prominent than the Duomo, black blueprint line art, photographic realism.
